field.name: actRetryNow
field.type: act(seq: number, action: 'retry-now') => { readonly ok: true } | { readonly ok: false; readonly note: string }
field.purpose: act also accepts 'retry-now': a retrying message becomes due at once (store.retryNow) and runs at the next tick; any other row is refused with a note

rationale: S004's outbox needs a retry-now button; the action goes through the worker like cancel, dismiss and resend (AMD-3). Built and approved in S004.
